Bill.BriefDescription: Earmarking sales taxes collected by park vendors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to earmarking sales taxes collected by parkvendors; adding a new section to chapter 82.32 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Fifty percent of the tax collected under RCW 82.08.020(1) bysellers in public parks during new events shall be distributed to thegovernmental entity that owns the park. As used in this section, "newevent" means a festival, promotion, or other event that is notsubstantially identical to an event held in the park before theeffective date of this section. (2) Money distributed under this section may be used only asadditional resources for the support of public parks and may not beused to supplant other sources of funding for those purposes. Moneydistributed under this section may not be used to purchase real estate.
